# onetsolutions_dns_zone (Data Source)

Looks up a DNS zone of a project by `id` or by `zone_name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "onetsolutions_dns_zone" "example" {
  zone_name = "example.com"
}

output "example_nameservers" {
  value = data.onetsolutions_dns_zone.example.nameservers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The UUID of the zone. Exactly one of `id` and `zone_name` is required.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization to read from. Defaults to the provider's `organization_id`.
- `project_id` (String) The project to read from. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.
- `zone_name` (String) The domain the zone serves, lowercase without a trailing dot. Exactly one of `id` and `zone_name` is required.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the zone was created (RFC 3339).
- `domain_id` (String) The UUID of the domain the zone serves, when there is one.
- `is_verified` (Boolean) Whether the domain is delegated to the zone's name servers.
- `mode` (String) `onetsolutions` (hosted) or `client` (hosted elsewhere).
- `nameservers` (List of String) The name servers assigned to the zone.
- `record_count` (Number) The number of records in the zone.
